style_prompt: Create a polished mobile game UI icon matching a warm, cozy Cat 2048 game. Lightly stylized 3D rendering, rounded tactile forms, warm cream, coral, honey yellow, and teal palette, dark warm-brown edge accents, soft upper-left key light, subtle lower-right contact shadow, clean transparent background. The icon must be readable at 56 to 80 pixels. Exactly one centered symbol, no frame, no text, no numbers, no letters, no watermark, no logo, no extra objects, no checkerboard background.

assets.prompt: A compact trail of exactly two cute coral cat paw prints, one slightly above the other, clearly communicating steps or moves. Bold simple silhouette, paws occupy about 78 percent of the square canvas.
Two small rounded cream cat tiles visibly merging toward one bright honey-yellow star sparkle in the center. Keep it as one compact symbol with a clear merge action and no arrows.
A tiny teal 2 by 2 rounded game grid with exactly one cream empty cell emphasized by a soft honey-yellow glow, clearly communicating available empty board spaces.
